profile_desc: Choose your username & country for the Leaderboard!
tip_popup_desc: Watch a short ad to get +3 Free Tips!
tutorial_welcome: Tap the unblocked arrow to shoot it!
tutorial_path_guide: Arrows hit enemies along the track!
boot_tip: TIP: Clear unobstructed arrows first to strike enemies!
boot_tip_0: TIP: Match arrow paths to guide every bot!
boot_tip_1: TIP: Blocked arrows bounce back safely without losing lives!
boot_tip_2: TIP: Use Freeze skill when enemies get too close to the portal!
boot_tip_3: TIP: Solvable arrows always have an unblocked exit path!
boot_tip_4: TIP: The final Rainbow Arrow clears the remaining wave in style!
tip_popup_subtitle: Watch an ad to get 1 hint
freeze_popup_subtitle: Watch an ad to get 1 freeze
puzzle_swipe: Tap or swipe left / right to rotate
puzzle_shapes_help: Clear the shape. Blocked arrows cost a life.
puzzle_color_help: Match the arrow to the exit wall color.
puzzle_stuck: No rotations left and no matching exit remains.
puzzle_restart_hint: Restart to restore the rotation budget.
puzzle_hint_rotate: Swipe once to match the next exit.
puzzle_hint_added: Hint added. Tap the bulb to use it.
puzzle_campaign_complete: Campaign complete! More levels coming soon.
puzzle_rocket_needed: Use the rocket to rescue an arrow
